statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the minimum number of w-rectangles needed to cover all points: (i) there exists a cover of all points by r w-rectangles, and (ii) for every integer k with 0 <= k < r, no cover of all points by k w-rectangles exists. Here a w-rectangle is a rectangle [a,b] x [0,Y] with a <= b, Y >= 0, and b-a <= w; it covers a point p iff a <= p[0] <= b and p[1] <= Y.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a Std.I64 result r (it does not fail, overflow, panic, or access out of bounds) for every input satisfying the preconditions.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r >= 1.

statement: The function returns a result r and r <= |{points[i][0] : 0 <= i < len(points)}|, the number of distinct x-coordinates among the points.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = |{points[i][0] : 0 <= i < len(points)}|.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; w = 0; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = 1.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct; max_{0 <= i < len(points)} points[i][0] - min_{0 <= i < len(points)} points[i][0] <= w.

statement: The function returns a result r and r = len(points).
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct; for every i,j with 0 <= i < j < len(points), |points[i][0] - points[j][0]| > w.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the maximum cardinality of a subset S of {0,...,len(points)-1} such that for all distinct i,j in S, |points[i][0] - points[j][0]| > w.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r is the smallest integer k such that the index set {0,...,len(points)-1} can be partitioned into k nonempty groups G_1,...,G_k satisfying: for every t with 1 <= t <= k and every i,j in G_t, |points[i][0] - points[j][0]| <= w.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r, and r depends only on the set X = {points[i][0] : 0 <= i < len(points)} and on w: for every valid list q of points with the same set of x-coordinates as points, min_rectangles_to_cover_points(q, w) returns r.
preconditions: len(points) >= 1 and len(points) <= 100000; for every i with 0 <= i < len(points), len(points[i]) = 2, 0 <= points[i][0] <= 10^9, and 0 <= points[i][1] <= 10^9; 0 <= w <= 10^9; all pairs (points[i][0], points[i][1]) are distinct.

statement: The function returns a result r, and for every integer W with W >= w, if r_W is the minimum number of rectangles [a,b] x [0,Y] with a <= b, Y >= 0, and b-a <= W needed to cover the same points, then r_W <= r.
